messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "more likely to cause problems if your potassium is low"
set: ["more likely to cause problems if your potassium is low", "low potassium", "older adults more likely to build up high potassium level", "low potassium levels", "low potassium or low sodium levels", "signs of low potassium", "more likely at higher doses", "more likely in severe cirrhosis", "more likely after long-term use", "more likely on longer courses", "low potassium can be managed with potassium supplements", "single large dose not likely to cause life-threatening symptoms", "can cause low birth weight", "talk to your doctor if more sensitive to pain", "more likely with rapid fluid loss", "more likely in people with depression"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
